\begin{abstract}
We describe NASA POWER's monthly mean air temperature at the Frankfurt grid cell from 2001 to 2023 (276 months) and forecast it. On the training years 2001--2020 the Mann--Kendall test finds an upward trend ($p = 0.0125$; Sen's slope 0.6984 degrees C per decade). A model of a linear trend and monthly means forecasts the 36 hold-out months with an RMSE of 1.788 degrees C, against 2.134 for the seasonal naive forecast, and its 95\% intervals cover 0.944 of them. The study makes no causal claim.
\end{abstract}
